ns2:section.sectionText: Branding isn’t just for companies. Every working professional has their own story to tell and goals, skills, and expertise to share. In today’s digital world, a personal brand is no longer a nice-to-have; it’s expected and particularly important to social media influencers, student athletes and online celebrities. This course will focus on practical strategies for building and maintaining a strong personal brand on social media for career advancement and social influence. Upon completion, students will develop advanced social media management skills to personal brand building and identify and manage threats to and risks involved in online reputation management. This course will help you create an authentic personal brand and amplify your career. Prerequisite: None
